name: openrig

scripts.test: npm run test:repo && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:repo: npm run build -w packages/daemon && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --import ./scripts/seat-path-preload.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-first-run-references.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-guard.mjs && node scripts/mirror-skills.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-context-packs.mjs --check
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run test -w packages/daemon -w packages/cli -w packages/tui -w packages/ui
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck:prep && tsc --noEmit --project packages/daemon/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/tui/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:daemon-tests && npm run typecheck:ui-tests && npm run typecheck:tui-tests && npm run typecheck:cli-tests

//: devDependencies (workspaces-o9o.125): @hono/node-ws and @hono/node-server 1.x are dev-only. packages/daemon/test/cross-host-messages.real.test.ts runs a real older daemon build (its OLD_BUILD), whose server.ts imports @hono/node-ws; these are the packages that build declared.
The daemon and the cli run on @hono/node-server 2 and never import @hono/node-ws; packages/cli/test/packaging-deps-mirror.test.ts fails if one starts to, or if a published manifest declares it.
